A group of lore seekers went to [[Athiss/Legends|Athiss]] to '''explore''' a [[Unidentified Sith Lord's tomb (Athiss)|tomb]] they mistakenly believed was of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. They arrive at the [[Far Orbit Resort and Lodge]] before journeying to the ruins.

At the tomb they meet [[Unidentified hermit (Athiss)|The Mad Hermit]] as well as a group of [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]].

In the tomb they encountered a manifestation of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] which took the image of the [[Unidentified Sith Lord (Athiss)|Sith Lord]].

In the end, the manifestation vanishes, along with the Sithspawn, allowing the to explore a cave of [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|Kyber crystals]].

==Behind the scenes==
The mission appears in the ''[[Lost Knowledge]]'' adventure in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Beta|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Beta]].
